## DG4 round 1 QA review: PASS, with two new Low findings (nothing blocking)

I reviewed frozen candidate `sha256:19656b1f…` (1449 files, source `a91d82c`). The ID matched in the repo and in two full clones, at the start and at the end. HEAD moved to `4434ec9` during the review, but nothing changed outside `docs/delivery/`. I found no product defect, nothing Critical or High, and no mandatory violation.

**Results**
- **Static checks:** all seven exit 0, including the OpenAPI lint (652 operations). The build prints a Vite warning that one chunk is over 500 kB; it is advisory only.
- **Unit (`pnpm test`):** 2771 tests, plus 259 passed and 2 skipped (by design), on Node 22 and Node 24 in both locale settings. Two first runs were not green:
  - Node 22 with C.UTF-8: one test (`architecture.test.ts`) took 34.9 s against its 30 s limit under heavy load. It passed when re-run.
  - Node 24 with C.UTF-8: my run was cut off by the agent's 30-minute background limit, not by a test. The re-run passed.
- **Integration:** 1922/1922 in each of two runs, covering migrations 0001–0060 and the contract test. All 40 `p4-pending` lists are empty. `tests/qa` alone: 172/172.
- **REQ-DLV-036 on the frozen candidate:** A04 8/8, A09 17/17, A10 16/16, A11 40/40, so 81/81.
- **e2e (real stack, English and Arabic, both locale settings):**
  - The 14 root acceptance tests pass in both runs (A03, A04, A08/A09, A20).
  - The product journeys pass 329 of 332 in each run. The one failure (two follow-on tests then don't run) is F-DG4-141; that spec passes 9/9 in both languages when run alone.
  - No product test timed out. The slowest took 27.0 s against a 30 s limit.
- **My own checks:**
  - An auditor and lead sweep of 59 P4 screens in both languages: 474 checks per language, 0 failed. It covers axe, language and direction, 390 px width, 200 % text, and the auditor sending no writes.
  - A probe of the database-schema half of the six entity-group requirements.
  - A REQ-S12-005 probe with two KPI owners.
  - A REQ-S13-001 probe showing dashboard totals contain no other-transformation figures.
  All pass.
- **Validators:** register DG4, pipeline, and historical DG3/DG2/DG1 all PASS.
- **Traceability:** every test file cited as evidence by all 137 requirements ran green in this review.

**My own test errors (disclosed in the record):**
- One probe expected a `status` column that is actually named `validation_status`.
- One probe had a wrong import.
- My first sweep version did not accept the product's by-design no-permission page. It also used an unbounded wait, so the lead pass stalled until its 30-minute timeout.

I fixed all of these and re-ran them green.

**Findings**

| ID | Severity | Owner | What |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG4-140 | Low (documentation, not mandatory) | transformation-analyst | The register notes for REQ-PB-010 and REQ-S03-004 still say there are test gaps. QA-D's tests, already in the candidate, close them, and neither row cites those tests as evidence. |
| F-DG4-141 | Low (test robustness, not mandatory) | frontend-ux-engineer | The product test "administration screens" (`journeys.spec.ts`) assumes the seeded Lead is on the first page of 25 users. In the Arabic project it fails when the product journeys and the acceptance specs run on one stack, because other test users push the Lead to page 2. This happened in both locale runs. |

**Partial-coverage disclosures in the register:** I judged all of them acceptable except REQ-PB-010 and REQ-S03-004 (F-DG4-140). One observation, not raised as a finding: REQ-PB-009's UI label is checked on screen only by a jsdom unit test, not on the real stack.

**Environmental residuals:** the live registry, live CI and Keycloak are each checked on their offline surface and recorded as PASS with the residual noted.

The record and findings sidecar both validate against their schemas. The leftover temporary folders in `$TMPDIR` are from the test harness, and the runner removes them when the run ends.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG4/round-1/qa-verifier.json`
- `reviews/DG4/round-1/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG4/round-1/qa-verifier.md`
- `test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-1/` (logs; start with `RUN-NOTES.md`)
- `test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-1/` (my three test files)
